subprocess_flow.substep_name: Verify Upstream Data Contracts and SLA Conformance
subprocess_flow.description: Evaluate incoming data feeds against machine-readable Data Contracts and upstream service level agreements. Automated schema diffing engines parse pre-compiled contract checks to intercept unexpected structural drift, semantic type deviations, or delivery cadence breaches prior to staging ingestion.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
success_criteria: 100% upstream partner data contract conformance verified pre-ingestion
Zero undetected upstream schema shifts or unauthorized structural changes
Pre-compiled data contract checks verified pre-ingestion
subprocess_flow.purpose: Intercept upstream data changes and enforce formal contractual specifications before unvetted data penetrates internal pipelines.
subprocess_flow.scope: All upstream partner data streams, external justice-sector data feeds, and third-party data deliveries.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of upstream data feed event and data provisioning notification
end_conditions: Verification report published confirming 100% data contract conformance or automated rejection ticket issued

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Silent schema modifications by external data providers breaking automated parsing jobs
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated pre-ingestion contract linting and schema diff validation halting ingest on discrepancy

governance_requirements: Central Digital and Data Office Data Sharing Standards

change_management.change_request_process: Contract amendments submitted via Data Governance Working Group with mandatory partner notification
change_management.versioning_rules: Data contract specifications versioned semantically in central schema repository

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Ingest Datasets and Execute Streaming Validation
subprocess_flow.description: Securely transfer approved data batches and real-time feeds into the MoJ isolated staging enclave. Streaming validation executors assess incoming transactions against cached data schema baselines with zero pipeline queueing delay, recording baseline syntax integrity and throughput telemetry.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
dependencies: Verify Upstream Data Contracts and SLA Conformance
success_criteria: Automated streaming validation active with zero pipeline queueing delay
100% of candidate records ingested without truncation or transmission corruption
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide high-speed, non-blocking staging ingestion and syntax validation using cached schemas to eliminate pipeline backlogs.
subprocess_flow.scope: Raw structured, semi-structured, and streaming datasets allocated to the AI system.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Successful validation of upstream data contracts and data landing in staging bucket
end_conditions: Execution logs committed and streaming validation metrics recorded in metadata registry

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Compute bottleneck and queue build-up during massive batch transfers
step_risks_and_controls.control: Distributed streaming workers using cached pre-compiled validation schemas

change_management.change_request_process: Schema baseline cache updates must be approved by Lead Data Engineer
change_management.versioning_rules: Dataset staging snapshots fingerprinted via SHA-256 and tracked in DVC/GitOps

improvement_inputs: Streaming validation latency and executor queue depth

subprocess_flow.description: Perform comprehensive tracing of data custody chains, source system event logs, and statutory collection authorities under the UK Data Protection Act 2018. Generate cryptographic lineage representations linking raw inputs to justice asset records and register the immutable graph within the MoJ Centralised Data Catalog.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
outputs: Immutable Data Lineage Record in Data Catalog
dependencies: Ingest Datasets and Execute Streaming Validation
success_criteria: Full data lineage recorded back to statutory authoritative sources
0 unclassified or unauthorized data elements identified
Lineage graph immutably stored in the MoJ Centralised Data Catalog
subprocess_flow.purpose: Establish verifiable evidentiary chains of custody and confirm legal authority for judicial data utilization.
subprocess_flow.scope: All upstream source databases, custody handoffs, and intermediate transformation records.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Completion of dataset staging ingestion and initial streaming validation
end_conditions: Catalog record locked and cryptographic lineage hash verified

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Inclusion of data assets lacking demonstrable legal basis or processing consent
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated provenance verification against IAO statutory asset register

change_management.change_request_process: Pipeline lineage updates submitted via MLOps registry pull request
change_management.versioning_rules: Lineage graphs tagged with semantic release versions matching pipeline build numbers

subprocess_flow.description: Dispatch parallelised profiling executors across distributed compute clusters to assess datasets against the six MoJ Data Quality Dimensions: completeness, accuracy, timeliness, validity, uniqueness, and consistency. Leverage caching to evaluate multi-million row databases concurrently without executor starvation.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
outputs: Parallelised Profiling and Automated Schema Validation Report
dependencies: Ingest Datasets and Execute Streaming Validation
success_criteria: >= 99.5% data profiling accuracy achieved across all dimensions
Parallelised validation completed without queueing backlog
Distributed parallel profiling executors operational without queue backlog
subprocess_flow.purpose: Detect statistical distribution skews, null density anomalies, and semantic invalidities at scale across high-volume judicial data.
subprocess_flow.scope: All structured and unstructured training, testing, and validation partitions.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Staged dataset availability and schema baseline confirmation
end_conditions: Generation of comprehensive profiling reports and cluster telemetry logs

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Executor crash or prolonged queue delays during processing of high-cardinality records
step_risks_and_controls.control: Auto-scaling parallel executor clusters with intermediate state checkpointing

change_management.change_request_process: Profiling dimension threshold modifications approved by Lead Data Steward
change_management.versioning_rules: Profiling rule suites and test manifests tracked under GitOps versioning

improvement_inputs: Data quality test suite failure rates

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Remediate Anomalies and Formulate Cleansing Manifest
subprocess_flow.description: Isolate records failing quality rules into an auditable quarantine container. Deterministic cleansing routines normalize formats, eliminate confirmed duplicate entries, and log every applied transformation to preserve distribution fidelity without silent data corruption.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
success_criteria: All cleansing transformations logged deterministically with reproducible code
100% of non-compliant records quarantined with root-cause reason codes
Zero silent mutations of underlying judicial distributions
subprocess_flow.purpose: Ensure pipeline data hygiene through auditable, deterministic remediation and record quarantine.
subprocess_flow.scope: All non-conforming data points flagged during parallelized profiling.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Delivery of automated profiling report flagging exceptions or anomalies
end_conditions: Cleaned dataset staged and Data Cleansing Manifest digitally signed by Data Steward

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Over-cleansing or aggressive imputation skewing ground truth statistical representation
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated distribution parity comparison between pre-cleansed and post-cleansed datasets

change_management.change_request_process: Cleansing rule adjustments submitted to Data Governance Board for review
change_management.versioning_rules: Remediated datasets hashed and versioned with immutable DVC tags

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Synthesize Quality Scorecard and CDO Release Gate
subprocess_flow.description: Collate contract verification outputs, lineage maps, profiling reports, and cleansing manifests into the official MoJ Data Quality Scorecard. Validate that the composite quality metric achieves or exceeds the mandatory 95% threshold, securing formal CDO digital approval to authorize release into AI engineering pipelines.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
outputs: MoJ Data Quality Scorecard (Completeness, Accuracy, Timeliness, Validity)
dependencies: Remediate Anomalies and Formulate Cleansing Manifest
success_criteria: Composite data quality score meets or exceeds the mandatory 95% threshold
Formal CDO digital sign-off and approval achieved
Quality certificate committed to Registered AI Use Case Record
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide final executive certification that dataset quality, contract conformance, and provenance are established before downstream consumption.
subprocess_flow.scope: The complete dataset release dossier for model development and fine-tuning.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Completion and consolidation of lineage maps and cleansing manifests
end_conditions: Data Quality Scorecard meeting minimum thresholds and formal CDO approval granted

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Ingestion of corrupted, incomplete, or unverified justice records due to silent upstream schema changes
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated parallel data quality rule enforcement with machine-readable data contract pre-validation and mandatory validation gate stopping data pipeline execution if score < 95% or schema violates contract

change_management.change_request_process: Scorecard threshold waivers require formal Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) exception authorization
change_management.versioning_rules: Scorecard artifacts archived with immutable cryptographic hash in Central Data Catalog

improvement_inputs: Data quality test suite failure rates
Downstream model retraining incidence due to data errors
